name: agent-sandbox-negotiation-benchmark
description:
Agent Sandbox Negotiation Benchmark v1
	


	
		
		Overview
	

A dataset of simulated multi-agent negotiations generated using the open-source Agent Sandbox framework. 
This dataset captures the final negotiation outcomes, turn depths, strategy alignments, and agreed prices of local LLMs (Llama-3 and Mistral) engaged in intense, adversarial price negotiations at massive scale.

	
		
		Dataset Statistics
	


Simulations: 24,122
Strategies: 4 (Balanced, Aggressive, Conservative, Adaptive)… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ScareRezume/agent-sandbox-negotiation-benchmark.
reputation: A niche, recent dataset for multi-agent negotiation research with growing but limited adoption outside the negotiation/agents community.
